later_review_audit.description: Sonarr compares the update package SHA-256 with the hash in its package metadata and rejects a mismatch. This is a source-level integrity observation; independent publisher authentication, automatic-update policy and historical release behavior are not certified here.
limitations: The separately pinned retrieved checkout is not proof of the original study release.

original_evidence.text: | Sonarr | Sonarr/Sonarr | .NET (C#, "NzbDrone" core) | Y | chk=auto (background `ApplicationUpdateCheckCommand`); dl/inst=fully automatic when Settings→General "Automatically Download and Install Updates" is enabled (`UpdateMechanism=BuiltIn`, `UpdateAutomatically=true`); otherwise notify-only | Y (fully automatic, no user click, when BuiltIn+auto-install enabled) | https, host `https://services.sonarr.tv/v1/`; TLS validation enforced by default .NET `HttpClient` — no `ServerCertificateValidationCallback`/`ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback` override anywhere in the update path (the only such override in the whole repo is in `Notifications/Email/Email.cs` for SMTP, unrelated to updates) | no (JSON `UpdatePackage` response from services.sonarr.tv is plain, unsigned) | hash-from-manifest (SHA256, field `Hash`, verified via `IVerifyUpdates.Verify` before extraction; throws `UpdateVerificationFailedException` on mismatch) | n/a — hash delivered inline in the HTTPS-fetched JSON manifest, no asymmetric signature | src/NzbDrone.Common/Cloud/SonarrCloudRequestBuilder.cs:15 (`https://services.sonarr.tv/v1/`); src/NzbDrone.Core/Update/UpdateVerification.cs:20-27 (`SHA256Hash()` compare); src/NzbDrone.Core/Update/InstallUpdateService.cs:126 (`_httpClient.DownloadFile`), :130 (`_updateVerifier.Verify`), :172 (`_processProvider.Start(updateClientExePath...)` launches Sonarr.Update client which does the file-swap+restart), :252/:331 (`UpdateAutomatically` gate) |
